description:
OVA of the manga by Sawaru Erect.

Miu had fallen in love with Haruka, the student council president. Acting upon her feelings, Miu sent Haruka a love letter, not knowing what the consequences of this action would be. A twisted tale of betrayal, revenge and love begins...

(Source: BakaBT)
